name: Wyoming

notes: Food for home consumption is exempt.
Barber and beauty services: not taxed (FTA 2017 survey answer).
Laundry and dry cleaning, and auto repair labor: taxed (FTA 2017 survey answer).
Motor fuel is exempt from the general sales tax (per-gallon excise instead).
Food is exempt from state and local sales taxes.
Tobacco is assumed taxed at the general rate (excise taxes left out); not verified state by state.
gaps: Wyoming resort districts (Teton Village and Grand Targhee, 2%) are not Census places and are not placed; tracts there take the Teton County rate.
2 place codes in the boundary file are not 2024 Census places and were left out: 5602290, 5602291

local: downtown development authority, funded in part by a mill levy in the district
